sloka: न शत्रुघ्नस्तथा जातो यथा ऽन्ये निर्जितास्त्वया ।तदद्य बाणाभिहतो व्रज त्वं यमसादनम् ।। ७.६९.४ ॥
transliteration: na śatrughnastathā jāto yathā 'nye nirjitāstvayā ।tadadya bāṇābhihato vraja tvaṁ yamasādanam ।। 7.69.4 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna declared that he was not like the others Lavaṇa had conquered, and therefore, Lavaṇa would today be struck by his arrows and go to the abode of Yama.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! उस ( देवनिर्भित ) घड़े से, जो मित्रावरुण के वीयं से हुआ था, दो तेजस्वी व्राह्मण उत्पन्न हुए
